title: On Lower Bounds for sums of Fourier Coefficients of Twist-Inequivalent Newforms
summary: In this article, we address the lower bounds for the sums $a_f(p)+a_g(p)$ of the $p$-th Fourier coefficients of two twist-inequivalent, non-CM normalized newforms $f$ and $g$. Our main result shows that for such forms with integer Fourier coefficients, the largest prime factor of $a_f(p)+a_g(p)$ satisfies $P(a_f(p)+a_g(p)) > (\log p)^{1/14} (\log \log p)^{3/7-ε}$ for almost all primes $p$ and for any $ε> 0$.
